description: Jumps the Rack view to any of ten saved places in the patch, restoring the zoom level saved with each of them.

params.text: Short-press jumps the view to what this slot holds; long-press binds the module clicked next, or clears the slot when one is already bound.

inputs.text: Fires the jump points by voltage: the first ten channels of a polyphonic cable fire points one to ten, or the menu takes notes C5 to A5 on a monophonic cable.

notes: Shift with the number keys 1 to 0 fires the jump points, until a cable is patched to the input.
a jump point does nothing until it holds a module: long-press its button and click a module, or use Learn current selection on that button's menu.
menu: Learn current selection — on a jump point button's own right-click menu, binding every module currently selected rather than a single one; Clear empties that point.
Jump position — Module centering or Module top left; Ignore zoom level keeps the current zoom, and Smooth transition slides the view instead of cutting to it.
Trigger port — Polyphonic trigger fires points one to ten from the channels of a polyphonic cable, and C5-A5 takes notes on a monophonic one.
